Pot Herbs

Do you remember Durkee used to make a mix of seasoning that you could use in soup or stew and that with a little salt and pepper was all you needed? Well, I went into several forums a couple years ago and everyone is asking the same thing, are they selling it anymore (No) and does anyone know the mix (No).

One person said she knew it was Thyme and Marjoram because she had an old can but did not know the ratio.

So then I began looking at recipes online that used both Thyme and Marjoram and it always seemed to be Thyme was used 4x more than Marjoram. So That is how I created my mix. 4 TBS of dried Thyme and 1 TBS Marjoram. Rub and crush between your fingers and mix them together real well.

Very good in chicken soups/broths and meat stews.

Use just a pinch at a time to taste and salt and pepper. These two herbs are strong and you don't need much more to flavor a soup or stew. I sometimes put a pinch in a cup of chicken broth just for a little flavor.
